items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: the wire came from a guy by the name of Dick (Voynow) who was the leader and the piano player with the Wolverines.

ctx.x: This was the Wolverines. With Bix Beiderbecke. And so I knew all the numbers off the records. Except the solos. I always played, we always had a rule with the Austin Highschool Gang, you play your own solo. So we knew all these numbers and I was playing a New Year's Eve job one night and Vic Moore the drummer who had been with the Wolverines and was not with them then, heard me. He said, man, You sound just like Bix you know. And I said, oh thanks, great.

So I got a wire a Western Union telegram, I'm going to Austin Highschool at the time, my second year, I'd almost finished my second year I think it was, starting the third year. And we had been playing a lot all around, professionally by then. I was seventeen years old. And the wire came from a guy by the name of Dick (Voynow) who was the leader and the piano player with the Wolverines.
How do you spell his last name?
